sanskrit_verse:
यदा तु नैव कश्चित् स्यात् कन्या राजानम् आव्रजेत् ।
अनुज्ञया तस्य वरं प्रतीत्य वरयेत् स्वयम् ॥
transliteration: yadā tu naiva kaścit syāt kanyā rājānam āvrajet | anujñayā tasya varaṃ pratītya varayet svayam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When no suitable groom is presented by the king, the maiden herself shall choose her husband through her own discernment, with the king's permission.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the sovereign to enable individual dharma
Causation arises from unmet duty requiring corrective action
Capacity-based responsibility assigns choice where discernment exists
Restoration logic ensures continuity of dharmic union
Consciousness alignment enables autonomous right selection
executable_legal_axioms: IF a maiden has no assigned suitor from the sovereign THEN she MAY autonomously select a spouse WITH royal consent
IF royal authority FAILS to provide suitable match THEN individual discernment SHALL activate WITHIN prescribed bounds
IF consent is granted BY ruler THEN self-selection QUALIFIES as lawful marriage initiation
supreme_court_application: In matters of marital autonomy, when state-appointed authority fails to fulfill its obligation of arranging appropriate unions, the Supreme Court must recognize and uphold the inherent capacity of the individual to exercise conscious selection under conditional royal approval.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that failure in arranged matching creates sequential necessity for self-determination; anupūrvaśaḥ validates conscious selection as corrective measure; proportional responsibility rests with the sovereign for initial omission; non-punitive reality affirms realignment through empowered choice rather than penalizing lack of arrangement.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: Royal acknowledgment of unmet duty
Responsibility assumption protocol: Activation of maiden's autonomous capacity
Capacity restoration: Facilitation of conscious discernment within dharma
Integrity reintegration: Formal validation of self-chosen union
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law executes pure Dharma: authority serves freedom, consciousness adjudicates truth, and reality remains eternally non-punitive.
